question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

A person who lacks competence and experience
solution:
The correct answer is **'Amateur'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The group of words describes a person who lacks skills and experience in a particular task or field. 
 
• This idea is encapsulated in the English word 'Amateur', and in Hindi, it is referred to as 'Shaukiya' (शौकिया).
 
• Example: Despite being an amateur, he showed great potential.
 
• 'Amateur' signifies a person who does something for enjoyment and doesn't have formal training or experience. In Hindi, it's called 'Shaukiya' (शौकिया).
 
• Example: He's an amateur golfer who plays for the love of the game.

Therefore, the correct answer is 'Option 4, Amateur'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• 'Proselyte' (नया धर्म स्वीकार करने वाला) is a person who has converted from one opinion, religion, or party to another.
 
• 'Expert' (विशेषज्ञ) is someone who is very knowledgeable or skillful in a particular area.
 
• 'Immature' (अपरिपक्व) refers to someone who isn't fully developed in the body or mind.
